improvementRoom: Standardize the lint gate repo-wide: ~19/26 packages define no `check` script and local_ci resolves gates by script NAME, so lint is silently skipped (only wayfind gates biome; hermes-memory/devops alias check=tsc). file2md: fix mock.module() cross-file leakage — 9 test files (ask-io, classify-vlm, explain-page, html-figures, mermaid, pipeline-v2, pptx-lane, smart-mode, svg-lane) register partial factories that pollute later-loaded suites; spread the real module (() => ({...real, fn: fake})) or use mock.restore()/afterAll cleanup so whole-suite `bun test` matches per-file reality.

hyperframes: make HOME sandboxing real — inject a base dir or resolve os.homedir() lazily per call instead of at import time; ~20 of 34 failures are real-user-state leakage, and the suite reads/writes actual ~/.media (misses.jsonl modified today) and ~/.hyperframes, making results machine-dependent and mutating real user data.

hyperframes: fix the two non-HOME clusters — resolve @hyperframes/* version pins from the package's own manifest via createRequire/import.meta (the directory walk breaks under bun-apps' isolated Bun linker, silently falling back to @latest), and make animation-map/contrast-report fixtures write the bundle entry explicitly (htmlBundler.js:715 'index.html not found in project directory').

Add a documented periodic opt-in lane (scheduled CI) for env-gated highest-risk suites — PI_AGENT_E2E=1 (archify e2e layers), devops deploy/L1 e2e, MLX_E2E/MLX_SMOKE=1 (movie-director real-silicon), PI_RUN_L2=1 (power-tool) — so opt-in-only paths cannot drift silently; also fix archify's inverted mermaid-convert.test.ts:322 skipIf(!!process.env.CI).

realIssues: s2-agent-ext-file2md — test gate (`bun test`) FAIL: 250 pass / 30 fail / 3 errors across 36 files (GATE_TEST_EXIT=1). Deterministic mock.module() cross-file leakage in the shared bun test process, NOT flake — every 'received' value matches a stub defined in another test file. Exact hits: resolve-vision-llm.test.ts 7 fails (resolveVisionLLM returns {provider:'zai', modelId:'glm-5.3-flash'} from another file's sessions.ts mock, ignoring saved config/PI_MODEL/tier); 3x SyntaxError 'Export named X not found' (countSlides src/raster/deck.ts, collapseCjkSpaces src/ocr/ocr.ts, resolveLLM src/sessions.ts) from partial mock factories in pptx-lane/html-figures/etc; vision-inference-guard.test.ts 8 fails (emptyIsError/empty-flag and cancel-lever externalSignal contract broken by a leaked runVisionInference mock); raster.test.ts bgraToBmp/bgraToPng and ocr.test.ts dims round-trips expect 6x4, receive 8x8 from the leaked stub imageDims:()=>({width:8,height:8}) (html-figures.test.ts:40, pipeline-v2:54, pptx-lane:75, smart-mode:52, svg-lane:44); svg-liveness.test.ts 3 fails (renderSvg*ToPng returns leaked TINY_PNG 64x48 ignoring livenessMs). Whole-suite gate is red; per-file runs pass — a test-isolation defect rather than a production regression, but the canonical gate genuinely fails.

s2-agent-ext-hyperframes — test gate FAIL: 34/359 failed (325 pass, 50 files). Mixed root causes, all reproducible on this machine: (a) HOME-sandbox leakage — code under test reads REAL ~/.media + ~/.hyperframes and ignores the tests' process.env.HOME: stats.mjs 'buildStats returns a zeroed report when nothing exists' 17 !== 0 (real ~/.media/manifest.jsonl leaked in); telemetry 'adopts a legacy ~/.media/anon-id' got fresh UUID 15793876-… instead of 'legacy-media-id'; prefs-store 'one project never promotes' expected undefined, got source:'user' confirmed_in:['my-launch','proj-a'] from real home data; candidates 'zero-overlap intent still lists candidates'/'caps per scope' 4 !== 1 (real global cache); (b) package-loader.mjs version-pin directory-walk fails under bun-apps' isolated Bun linker → '@hyperframes/producer@latest' !~ /^@hyperframes\/producer@\d+\.\d+\.\d+/ (2 test fails + stderr @latest fallback warning); (c) 7 animation-map/contrast-report + 4 transient-init retry tests fail with 'error: index.html not found in project directory' at @hyperframes/core htmlBundler.js:715 via package-loader.mjs:62 (fixtures don't write the bundler entry file). Safety-relevant: the suite reads AND may write real user state (~/.media/misses.jsonl modified today). Environment-dependent but deterministic test-isolation/fixture defects; typecheck clean.
synthesis.summary: 26-package sweep: 24 green on test+typecheck; 2 red test gates — file2md (30 fail/3 err, deterministic mock.module() cross-file leakage, per-file runs pass) and hyperframes (34 fail: HOME-sandbox leakage reading real ~/.media, linker-broken version pins, bundler fixture misses).
